newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar closes flat in moderate trading.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar closes flat in moderate trading.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed almost flat on Wednesday at (US$0.7380) from Tuesday's close at C$1.3557 (US$0.7377) in moderate trading, dealers said. * They said the Canadian currency stuck to a narrow range, overshadowed by heavy activity in U.S. dollars and the German mark.
But the Canadian unit regained its strength during early daytime trading, and stuck to a tight range for the rest of the day.
Traders expected the currency to trade quietly again overnight, since no relevant news is expected soon.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar climbed to 1.2457 marks from Tuesday's 1.2370 marks and rose to 91.65 yen from 90.87 yen on Tuesday.
